rules.title: Defensive Type Checking
rules.check: Functions must validate parameter types at boundaries.
rules.rationale: Without compile-time types, runtime validation prevents type errors. Boundary validation catches issues early.

rules.title: Null Checks
rules.check: Nullable values must be checked before use.
rules.rationale: Null reference errors are common in JavaScript. Explicit checks prevent crashes and clarify logic.

rules.title: Array Bounds
rules.check: Array index access must be bounds-checked when index is variable.
rules.rationale: Out-of-bounds access returns undefined, not an error. Explicit checks catch logic errors.

rules.title: Error Handling
rules.check: All potentially throwing operations must have error handling.
rules.rationale: Unhandled exceptions crash applications. Proper error handling enables graceful degradation.

rules.title: Input Validation
rules.check: All external input must be validated before processing.
rules.rationale: External input is untrusted by definition. Validation prevents injection and logic errors.

rules.title: Safe JSON
rules.check: JSON.parse must be wrapped in error handling.
rules.rationale: JSON.parse throws on invalid input. Network responses and user input may contain invalid JSON.

rules.title: Date Handling
rules.check: Date parsing must validate results. Invalid Date must be detected and handled.
rules.rationale: Invalid date strings produce Invalid Date, not errors. Invalid Date propagates silently through calculations.

rules.title: Number Safety
rules.check: Numeric operations must guard against NaN, Infinity, and precision issues.
rules.rationale: JavaScript numbers have edge cases that produce unexpected results. Validation ensures correct calculations.

rules.title: Prototype Safety
rules.check: Object property access must not traverse prototype chain unexpectedly.
rules.rationale: Prototype pollution and inherited properties cause security and logic issues. Object.hasOwn must be used.

rules.title: Event Handler Safety
rules.check: Event handlers must not throw unhandled exceptions.
rules.rationale: Exceptions in event handlers can break application state. Handlers must catch and log errors.

rules.title: Regex Safety
rules.check: User input in RegExp MUST be escaped. Use libraries for complex patterns to avoid ReDoS.
rules.rationale: Unescaped user input enables injection. Complex patterns can cause catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS attacks).

rules.title: URL Construction
rules.check: Use URL constructor instead of string concatenation for building URLs.
rules.rationale: String concatenation is error-prone and can create invalid URLs. URL constructor handles encoding and validation automatically.
